bootstrap.scheme: Resample represented years with replacement, retaining each occurrence's distinct months. Common draws across methods within a group; restart RNG per group. Existing four raw contrasts only.
bootstrap.scope: Marginal paired test-year percentile 95% intervals; no familywise correction, training-threshold uncertainty, seed-population, refitting or selection uncertainty. Empty groups have no contrasts; single-year intervals are unavailable. No two-year intervals or p-values.

cutoff_definitions.dimensionless_cancellation: Window mean of C=(m^2-sum(mu^2))/m^2; bin ratio is zero when m^2=0.
cutoff_definitions.energy: Window mean of Q=(m^2+v_s)/B_ref_sq over the stated bins.
cutoff_definitions.population: All saved TRAIN windows, equal window weight, including overlapping windows. Not deduplicated bins and not month balanced; TEST never fits cutoffs.
cutoff_definitions.tie_policy: High strictly exceeds the 75th-percentile cutoff; equality is rest. Energy quartiles use searchsorted(side='right')+1, so equality goes above every tied edge. Empty quartiles are retained; counts are not forced equal. No clipping.

scope.claims: The full-test month-balanced primary endpoint is unchanged. No all-Gaussian or neural universality claims; source and calendar mixes are descriptive, not causal.
scope.context: Groups use only the actual 36 observed conditioning bins, not hidden targets. Still exploratory secondary analyses, not causal interventions or confirmatory superiority tests.
scope.fixed: Existing 18 primary procedures, fixed checkpoints and ensembles only. Three individual diffusion seeds, one shared realization per control; never pool 117 draws. No refit, redraw, selection, gradients or change to primary case selection.
scope.target: Outcome-selected descriptive associations. Conditioning on realized targets can reverse a proper-score ranking even for a correct forecast. Subgroup rankings do not establish conditional-distribution superiority or calibration.
scope.timing: Implemented after inspection of the original results, using the original documented training-derived rules. Not a new prospective registration or restored blind confirmation.
scope.validation: Loader checks score, checkpoint-selection and ensemble identities and ensemble payload integrity. Scores are aggregated, not recomputed from draws; checkpoint training and selection are not rerun. Original completion-linked outputs are hash-checked, not recalculated. Raw OMNI and the normalizer fit are not independently reconstructed. Full training feature arrays are not published.

source_inventory_scope: Producer source keys are repository-relative; input inventory keys are study-relative. Hashes identify actual source bytes, not rewritten historical summary or gradient producers.

weighting.mean: Equal windows per fixed seed, then equal seed mean. Realized feature means are descriptive under both weightings.
weighting.month_balanced: Equal represented-month means per fixed seed, then equal seed mean.
